scope: All entries and named values in manifest. Booleans, element modifiers and states are examined when they intersect named values; they are not additional named-axis value rows. Source-level deletion review; no modified-component browser render is claimed.

method.css: Balanced CSS scanner; comma alternatives and :is/:where branches expanded; :not references are exclusions, not prerequisites. At-rule ancestry retained. CSS evidence includes original selectors.
method.react: TypeScript AST inventory plus reviewed derivations, literal defaults and cross-family class-helper calls. Child dependency is conditional on the documented branch. Forwarded public axes outside parent manifest are marked borrowedPublicAxis.
method.demos: All demo TS/TSX searched; literal same-element and nested combinations indexed. Wrapper/default-only coverage is marked not found when a direct occurrence cannot be established.
method.specs: All spec files scanned; family maps include shared specs. Mentions support review, not a claim that all co-occurring values are inseparable.
method.defaults: Two distinct counterfactuals: prune CSS only, or remove the default from allowed values while leaving code/defaults unchanged. classesFor probes use built dist on cloned manifests; authored CSS fallback is not a computed-style snapshot.

reviewedNotes.text: Alert chooses its live-region role from the raw tone prop before the helper fills a default; changing the manifest default to danger would not update that role automatically. Overlay surface classes use manifest defaults while anchored wrappers use their own side defaults (Popover bottom, Tooltip top); placement is also expressed by runtime data-side.
reviewedNotes.fix: Resolve each generated default once before both behavior and class construction, and keep actual overlay placement authoritative after collision handling.

reviewedNotes.text: Input maps its raw size prop to Spinner sm/lg, otherwise md, without consulting a newly chosen Input manifest default. Switch always creates a default Spinner. Button bypasses Spinner React and emits area-spinner--md directly; removing that class leaves the base icon-md metric instead of the explicit space-16 metric. Equality is not assumed across custom themes.
reviewedNotes.fix: Resolve generated size once and pass the resolved size into the loading part, or make its dimensions private to the parent. Generate away raw public modifier classes that reference excluded choices.

reviewedNotes.text: MenuItem switch indicators use native markup with area-switch--sm. No classesFor call validates it; pruning sm CSS silently falls back to the larger Switch base geometry.
reviewedNotes.fix: Make the menu toggle an internal sized part or record and resolve its selected Switch size in the generated composition contract.

reviewedNotes.text: The outOfOffice flag maps away/offline to the out-of-office glyph and busy to unknown. These are shared glyph resources, not assignments of another status CSS class; the original status remains the helper argument.
reviewedNotes.fix: Keep glyph resources reachable from retained status/flag combinations when pruning assets. Do not mistakenly require the public out-of-office or unknown status just to reuse its mark.

reviewedNotes.text: ButtonGroup examples use ghost children for both soft and outline groups. InputGroup soft examples retain default outline NumberFields. These are child contracts, not evidence that same-named parent and child variants must be paired. Group CSS overrides geometry/paint without assigning React props.
reviewedNotes.fix: Declare a group child presentation contract and regenerate examples from retained child variants. Do not infer same-name dependencies from gallery tiles.

reviewedNotes.text: Each manifest models ground as one axis, but React exposes subtle and onColor booleans that can both be true. Later on-color declarations override subtle background; neither ground needs the other.
reviewedNotes.fix: Expose one optional ground enum, or explicitly document precedence and generate compatibility booleans only for retained values. Keep comma-separated Code/Token rule branches independently.

reviewedNotes.text: Deprecated inline forces orientation=horizontal even when orientation is vertical. This is an alias to a value, not a requirement for vertical.
reviewedNotes.fix: Remove the alias when horizontal is omitted, or validate/map it to the generated orientation policy.

reviewedNotes.text: Deprecated quiet overrides appearance; Kbd builds classes manually and bypasses classesFor validation.
reviewedNotes.fix: Generate the quiet alias and hard defaults together with the retained appearance/size lists; route class construction through the generated helper.

reviewedNotes.text: Kind is inferred from count rather than accepted as a kind prop. A status with no count delegates to Presence; online maps to available. Removing dot/count from the manifest alone leaves a branch that explicitly requests the removed value.
reviewedNotes.fix: Generate the count/status API branches from retained kinds; define a deliberate fallback or reject unsupported combinations before calling the helper.

reviewedNotes.text: ChipLink always requests suggestion. The ordinary Chip defaults filter and only filter has selectable behavior; other kinds do not require filter CSS.
reviewedNotes.fix: Omit ChipLink when suggestion is excluded, or use a generated link-specific part whose paint does not require an omitted public kind. Rewrite the ordinary Chip default separately.

reviewedNotes.text: Overflow copies the first truthy child size and resolves Badge soft/neutral defaults. The inline/overlay axis does not supply an independent overflow appearance.
reviewedNotes.fix: Give the generated overflow part a retained treatment and explicit size policy; avoid retaining public Badge values solely to support the hidden trigger.

reviewedNotes.text: The toolbelt exhibits ghost+iconOnly SplitButton. The spec describes that composition, but CSS defines ghost and iconOnly separately; ghost is not restricted to icon-only content.
reviewedNotes.fix: Keep the width-based corner correction conditional on both flags; regenerate toolbelt examples if ghost or iconOnly is omitted.

reviewedNotes.text: Dense shortcuts pair small+quiet, but each has standalone CSS. CommandPalette hard-codes that pair; a standalone small keycap or normal quiet shortcut is possible.
reviewedNotes.fix: Treat CommandPalette shortcut size/appearance as generated part options; do not merge Kbd size and appearance into one axis.
